import base64,hashlib,json,os,stat
from pathlib import Path
payload=json.loads('[{"name":"run_c4_synthetic_census.py","sha256":"856a61b997d26efa7d62f8176c745eb7a236e5e75db4f4e8cf50d90a09eb14c7","base64":""},{"name":"test_elf_capture.py","sha256":"64489779d88a399040e20f939fe878f8d20fa86a60b435a2d7896186dc64d87a","base64":""}]')
base=Path('/home/qian-qi/work/chain-joint-20261105-93bfc-w1-native-C4')
assert base.is_dir() and base.resolve()==base
folder=base/"tools"
assert folder.resolve()==folder
folder.mkdir(mode=0o700,exist_ok=True)
for item in payload:
    name=item["name"]
    assert name==Path(name).name
    raw=base64.b64decode(item["base64"],validate=True)
    assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==item["sha256"]
    path=folder/name
    if path.exists():
        info=path.stat(follow_symlinks=False)
        assert stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and info.st_nlink==1
        assert path.read_bytes()==raw
    else:
        descriptor=os.open(path,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o400)
        with os.fdopen(descriptor,"wb") as stream:
            stream.write(raw)
        assert path.read_bytes()==raw
